title: A Locker for the Homecoming
author: K. M. Voss
blurb: Bram Lockridge, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
